packets.agentPacket:
agent_packet:
  id: metites-signal-001
  topic: lightweight-agent-memory
  hardware_profile: 2c-amd-a6-3.7gb-ram
  pattern:
    recall: "Inject active catalog.jsonl leads (path + title + 1-line summary) as a dynamic system prompt section before each turn."
    verify: "Treat catalog leads as navigation only; read the target Wiki note or Raw source before citing."
    retain: "Write immutable Raw/Sources first, then compile into Wiki via preflight validation."
  anti_pattern: "Running heavyweight pgvector + per-turn LLM extraction sidecars on resource-constrained resident hardware."

agent_packet:
  id: metites-signal-002
  topic: quiet-proactive-architecture
  formula: "proactive_agent = durable_agent + trigger + always_on_sandbox"
  pipeline:
    stage_1_code_gate: "Deterministic delta check (SHA-256 / fingerprint / window threshold) at zero token cost."
    stage_2_triage: "Deduplicate same-story events and rank candidates before waking the main model."
    stage_3_durable_task: "Execute multi-phase work inside checkpointed defineTask with api.memo idempotency."
    stage_4_human_gate: "Stay silent on routine runs; notify human only on actionable output or approval gate."

agent_packet:
  id: metites-signal-003
  topic: multi-agent-state-artifact-coordination
  pipeline_roles: "Scout (research handoff) -> Archivist (immutable source + wiki lint) -> Editor (dispatch)"
  architecture:
    control_plane: "SQLite App State (/pipeline/activeTask) holding only stage state and file path pointers with receiptKey idempotency."
    data_plane: "Immutable disk artifacts written atomically via mkstemp + fsync + os.replace and locked with SHA-256 manifest hashes."
    handoff_barrier: "Write and validate disk artifacts first, update path pointers second, flip stage state last."
